name: taskproof-ai
description: Local-first bounty due-diligence and evidence readiness planner with open-weight FLAN-T5

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.mjs --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=docs/assets/app.js && esbuild src/ai-worker.mjs --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outfile=docs/assets/ai-worker.js --loader:.wasm=file && mkdir -p docs/assets/ort && cp node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm docs/assets/ort/ && cp src/styles.css docs/assets/styles.css
